responsibility: Declares the Rust frontend’s public Unicode string and normalization interface. It defines Utf8String as a validated UTF-8 wrapper built from decoded Codepoint vectors, exposes conversion back to std::string and NFC normalization, and declares the Unicode property predicates and NFC quick-check API used by lexing and identifier handling code to reason about alphabetic, numeric, and normalization-sensitive characters.
same_name_distinction: Header half of the rust-unicode pair: it defines the Utf8String wrapper and declares normalization/property-query APIs such as nfc_quick_check, is_alphabetic, and is_numeric, while rust-unicode.cc supplies the table-driven normalization algorithms and predicate implementations.
